question: dame la tasa de aprobación en porcentaje de cada esquema de tarjeta, ordenada de mayor a menor
sql: SELECT card_scheme, 100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN auth_status = 'approved' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*) AS tasa_de_aprobacion FROM v_attempt_dedup WHERE NOT is_test GROUP BY card_scheme ORDER BY tasa_de_aprobacion DESC
